tagline: A quiet eye on your repositories
brief: A compact desktop monitor for repository updates, designed to stay clear in the tray, app window and documentation.
criteria: A distinctive W that remains readable in small sizes and in one colour.

concepts.name: Watch Path
concepts.idea: A strong W and a single point turn continual observation into a compact mark.
rationale: The W remains legible at small sizes.
The point suggests a watched change.
Forest and lime carry forward the existing identity.

recommendation: Watch Path: a focused, simple identity for the desktop and system tray.
